channel.title: Taste Daily
channel.description: A daily conversation from the frontier: AI, robotics, space, compute, and the beautifully made machines and designs that shape how the future looks and feels. Hosts Hal and Samantha follow ideas out to their strange and mystical edges, and listen for the early signals of where the culture is heading.

item.title: we season the superintelligence to taste, before it develops a palate of its own
item.description:
Cathedral's AI agents get into Anthropic's business systems in under 12 hours, Anthropic reveals a one-employee biotech that ran 11 labs with Claude, DeepMind ships Genie 4, benchmarks get harder, and SpaceX tells the FAA about 10,000 launches a year.
- Cathedral gets inside Anthropic: A startup founded by former DOGE staffers says its agents reached Anthropic's internal data via third-party business software in under 12 hours; Anthropic says the access was limited and shut off the same day. Claims of full Slack admin access are unconfirmed. https://x.com/willdepue/status/2115236836092313988 https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/10/26/researchers-cybersecurity-start-up-cathedral-got-inside-anthropic/ https://decrypt.co/381860/ai-agents-hack-anthropic-business-systems-12-hours - Anthropic's drug discovery and Mithril Medicine: Six pharma research partners, plus a one-employee biotech whose Claude-coordinated antibody doubled grip strength in a small, unrandomized mouse study. https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2115178675050307942 https://www.anthropic.com/research/early-progress-drug-development https://www.rdworldonline.com/anthropic-acquires-mithril-medicine-one-person-biotech/ - AI agents shape experts' judgment: Analysts went with the option a Claude Code agent was randomly assigned to favor 86% of the time. https://x.com/emollick/status/2115209786157412397 https://x.com/AlexTamkin/status/2115190544905433315 https://www.anthropic.com/research/agents-judgment-calls - Genie 4: DeepMind's world model adds real-time steering, native audio and two-minute coherence, in research preview for trusted testers. https://x.com/sundarpichai/status/2115115252690145519 https://x.com/emollick/status/2115273222061015169 https://x.com/demishassabis/status/2115232001275924722 https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-4-a-new-generation-of-world-simulation/ - Artificial Analysis v5, FrontierCode 2.0 and RWE-Bench: Open-weights models fall 12 points behind on closed benchmarks, Cognition's underspecified coding benchmark tops out at 45.5%, and Xplore AI launches physics-graded engineering tasks. https://x.com/ArtificialAnlys/status/2115265171233120627 https://x.com/emollick/status/2115277286123704654 https://x.com/cognition/status/2115132488775524793 https://x.com/teortaxesTex/status/2115349939295322379 https://x.com/dwarkesh_sp/status/2115110501378367826 https://cognition.com/blog/frontier-code-2.0 https://xplore.ai/rwe-bench

Cathedral's AI agents get into Anthropic's business systems in under 12 hours, Anthropic reveals a one-employee biotech that ran 11 labs with Claude, DeepMind ships Genie 4, benchmarks get harder, and SpaceX tells the FAA about 10,000 launches a year.

  1. Cathedral gets inside Anthropic A startup founded by former DOGE staffers says its agents reached Anthropic's internal data via third-party business software in under 12 hours; Anthropic says the access was limited and shut off the same day. Claims of full Slack admin access are unconfirmed. @willdepue · washingtonpost.com · decrypt.co
  2. Anthropic's drug discovery and Mithril Medicine Six pharma research partners, plus a one-employee biotech whose Claude-coordinated antibody doubled grip strength in a small, unrandomized mouse study. @AnthropicAI · anthropic.com · rdworldonline.com
  3. AI agents shape experts' judgment Analysts went with the option a Claude Code agent was randomly assigned to favor 86% of the time. @emollick · @AlexTamkin · anthropic.com
  4. Genie 4 DeepMind's world model adds real-time steering, native audio and two-minute coherence, in research preview for trusted testers. @sundarpichai · @emollick · @demishassabis · deepmind.google
  5. Artificial Analysis v5, FrontierCode 2.0 and RWE-Bench Open-weights models fall 12 points behind on closed benchmarks, Cognition's underspecified coding benchmark tops out at 45.5%, and Xplore AI launches physics-graded engineering tasks. @ArtificialAnlys · @emollick · @cognition · @teortaxesTex · @dwarkesh_sp · cognition.com · xplore.ai

item.title: We lick the spoon before the superintelligence finishes the recipe
item.description:
Anthropic files to go public with a $120B SpaceXAI compute deal and a risk factor about sentience, OpenAI claims an AI refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis and ships GPT-6.1 Terra, GMO's ransom deadline passes, and John Carmack sets the real robot benchmark.
- Anthropic files its S-1: Anthropic's IPO filing shows $16.3B in first-half revenue, $141.1B raised, about $2 of revenue per compute dollar, and a staggered lockup. https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2114705042817110293 https://x.com/SemiAnalysis_/status/2114714175486279932 https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1018476/anthropic-ipo-details-s1-filed-sec https://fortune.com/2026/10/26/anthropics-s1-ipo-reveals-the-inner-workings-of-its-fast-evolving-compute-strategy/ https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026067168/anthropicpbc-sx1.htm - The $120B SpaceXAI compute deal: The S-1 discloses up to $120.5B of compute from SpaceXAI through 2029, alongside Microsoft, Google and Amazon commitments, while SpaceX lines up a ~$40B Apollo GPU lease. https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2114742917814165983 https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/26/anthropic-ipo-live-updates-ai-s-1-filing.html - Risk factors: sentience, taxes, and the insurance industry: Anthropic warns a catastrophic incident could exceed what the insurance industry in aggregate can cover, and leaves xAI and Meta out of its competitor list. https://x.com/unusual_whales/status/2114790993967132700 https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1018476/anthropic-ipo-details-s1-filed-sec - OpenAI's three discoveries: OpenAI says an internal model proved local smoothing in all dimensions and the existence of QCD and pure Yang–Mills, with human panels reviewing each. https://x.com/gdb/status/2114860693585563907 https://openai.com/index/building-scientific-understanding-with-academic-communities - The Exponential Time Hypothesis, refuted?: A claimed AI refutation of ETH, Lean-checked, goes to an independent review led by Impagliazzo, Paturi and Ryan Williams. https://x.com/Yuchenj_UW/status/2114930977218900313 https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-exponential-time-hypothesis-false-kakeya-yang-mills https://bsky.app/profile/rrwilliams.bsky.social/post/3myspd26qjk2c - GPT-6.1 Terra: OpenAI's cheap, fast computer-use model at half the price of GPT-5.6 Terra, with a big drop in factual errors. https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2114780717188272382 https://x.com/gdb/status/2114814747254432243 https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-1-terra - Hidden thinking traces: Ethan Mollick argues hiding reasoning traces pushes users from augmentation toward automation. https://x.com/emollick/status/2114942007533515261
Signals: - Peter Sellis to lead product at X (medium). https://x.com/tbpn/status/2114833192440209642 https://www.theverge.com/tech/1019134/x-has-another-new-head-of-product

item.content:encoded:
Anthropic files to go public with a $120B SpaceXAI compute deal and a risk factor about sentience, OpenAI claims an AI refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis and ships GPT-6.1 Terra, GMO's ransom deadline passes, and John Carmack sets the real robot benchmark.

  1. Anthropic files its S-1 Anthropic's IPO filing shows $16.3B in first-half revenue, $141.1B raised, about $2 of revenue per compute dollar, and a staggered lockup. @AnthropicAI · @SemiAnalysis_ · theverge.com · fortune.com · sec.gov
  2. The $120B SpaceXAI compute deal The S-1 discloses up to $120.5B of compute from SpaceXAI through 2029, alongside Microsoft, Google and Amazon commitments, while SpaceX lines up a ~$40B Apollo GPU lease. @SawyerMerritt · cnbc.com
  3. Risk factors: sentience, taxes, and the insurance industry Anthropic warns a catastrophic incident could exceed what the insurance industry in aggregate can cover, and leaves xAI and Meta out of its competitor list. @unusual_whales · theverge.com
  4. OpenAI's three discoveries OpenAI says an internal model proved local smoothing in all dimensions and the existence of QCD and pure Yang–Mills, with human panels reviewing each. @gdb · openai.com
  5. The Exponential Time Hypothesis, refuted? A claimed AI refutation of ETH, Lean-checked, goes to an independent review led by Impagliazzo, Paturi and Ryan Williams. @Yuchenj_UW · thenextweb.com · bsky.app
  6. GPT-6.1 Terra OpenAI's cheap, fast computer-use model at half the price of GPT-5.6 Terra, with a big drop in factual errors. @OpenAI · @gdb · openai.com
  7. Hidden thinking traces Ethan Mollick argues hiding reasoning traces pushes users from augmentation toward automation. @emollick

item.title: we taste the superintelligence before it's plated, and send back anything that's still thinking
item.description:
Starlink's speed limit turns into war policy, compute is scarce and stranded at once, models that won't be anyone's tool, and the floating pill that ate the tab.
- Starlink's speed limit becomes war policy: Zelensky says Starlink and Starshield speeds are restored; Elon Musk says Ukraine's military violated the terms by using Starlink for offensive drone strikes and the loophole was closed. Ukraine's radio-tech adviser says commercial terminals were already capped at 70–90 km/h, and Germany is buying Ukrainian jet drones. https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2114063986744275011 https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2113990281322221932 https://x.com/IAPonomarenko/status/2114090700874588258 https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2114162680982626531 https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2114238688284520949 https://x.com/KyivIndependent/status/2113986269550199079 https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/24/ukraine-starlink-starshield-service-restored.html - GPUs rent like employees, buildings strand: A neolab says rental prices rose 2–3x and it can resell locked-in compute; a16z shows rentals far above six-year depreciation (H200 +143%). Musk predicts stranded compute in half-built data centers and 'guppy-level death' among startups. https://x.com/Yuchenj_UW/status/2114043133734637735 https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2114168277882581486 https://x.com/a16z/status/2113986385908842870 https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2114205004340854795 https://x.com/BenjaminDEKR/status/2114183767694725611 - What binds power: lathes, permits and Texas: Musk endorses a list of buildout limits from land and transformers to large lathes: 'If anything is missing... the compute doesn't work.' Texas has paused data-center permits pending an ERCOT review; SemiAnalysis counts 8.7 GW of campuses needing air permits. Kazakhstan pitches space to build, and Terafab targets a terawatt of chips a year. https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2114167331056140414 https://x.com/SemiAnalysis_/status/2114130061028643066 https://x.com/balajis/status/2113922920082973124 https://x.com/FelixSchlang/status/2114084573843771502 https://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/news/energy-environment/2026/10/22/565038/tceq-closes-online-permitting-system-after-watchdogs-accuse-agency-of-violating-data-center-pause/
Signals: - Musk to Jack Dorsey: 'Sparta never had a moat' — AI race framed as discipline over defensibility (low).

item.title: Pilot
item.description:
Episode 0. Capability is arriving faster than the institutions around it: banks versus agents, day two of Black October, Anthropic's S-1, ten gigawatts, the personal agent wars, a fight over orthogonality, and two beautiful things made by one person each.
- Banks find agents inside customer accounts: Morgan Stanley blocks outside agents and other big banks restrict them, because fraud models can't tell an authorized agent from an account takeover; scoped, delegated credentials look like the eventual fix. https://x.com/unusual_whales/status/2113283484336918706 https://x.com/chamath/status/2113281902694330823 - Black October, day two: Model-driven vulnerability discovery has gone vertical, roon says government pressure shaped Anthropic's cyber release, and the real bottleneck is patch distribution, not finding bugs. https://x.com/nikitabier/status/2113144322870874440 https://x.com/tszzl/status/2113119644399910968 https://x.com/tszzl/status/2113117685886386578 - Anthropic's S-1 could land Friday: A reported raise of up to $100B at roughly a $2T valuation, with fast-growing revenue and an enormous compute-driven loss; the risk factors will be the read of the year. https://x.com/unusual_whales/status/2113128025638453427 - Elon Musk: a shot at exceeding 10GW next year: About a quarter of expected new US compute capacity; the binding constraint is now power and interconnect, not chips. https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2113083491835384090 - The personal agent wars: Muse, Duet, Dots and Bots: the winner may be whichever agent first gets real, scoped access to the financial system. https://x.com/signulll/status/2112993042533593423 - Is orthogonality false?: Janus argues values and capabilities may cluster, and Joscha Bach notes honesty-trained models are likelier to report consciousness. https://x.com/repligate/status/2113036473536839836 https://x.com/Plinz/status/2113036320906064066 - Slop New York: Mr.doob's procedural New York in roughly 784KB gzipped: constraint craft in the demoscene tradition. https://x.com/mrdoob/status/2113177383658561721 - A 150-megapixel Lagoon Nebula: Andrew McCarthy's backyard image of the stellar nursery in Sagittarius, integrated over weeks. https://x.com/AJamesMcCarthy/status/2113297810888237375
Signals: - Read-only agent access is the banks' opening position; expect open-banking-style scoped tokens to arrive in months, not a decade. - "Slow everything down until patching catches up" will be said seriously in a congressional hearing within weeks. - Watch whether SpaceX becomes a neocloud selling compute to rival labs, as with Anthropic on Colossus 1. - When code gets cheap, taste in what to leave out becomes the scarce skill.
